body:
Real, shared RL checkpoint registry for SHANKPIT, mirroring BRAWLPIT's own
established registry (internal/brawlpit/checkpoint_store.go) field-for-field,
scoped down (no weights export, no match-result/Elo -- neither has a real
SHANKPIT consumer yet).

New: shankpit_rl_checkpoints table, internal/shankpit/checkpoint_store.go,
internal/http/handlers/shankpit_checkpoints.go (9 new store tests, all
passing), frontend/nock/src/ShankpitAiOpponents.tsx (new "SHANKPIT AI
Opponents" NOCK tab).

Disable and Hide Disabled are real and fully wired. "Set as opponent" is
deliberately deferred per the founder's own explicit instruction: the
button exists, but shows a DaisyUI alert instead of calling the real,
already-wired backend endpoint.

Frontend builds clean, new component verified in the built bundle. Live
IDUNA redeployed and health-checked; new endpoints verified live.

Commit: IDUNA@6819a7d.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-49: real SHANKPIT bot registry affordances on NOCK -- disable, hide disabled, deferred set-default
